boards.title: Your First Weekend at Texas Christian University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A paced, under-21-safe first-weekend route through named campus landmarks, student spaces, and nearby Fort Worth culture.

cards.title: Begin at Frog Fountain
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • Campus Commons
cards.notes: Meet your group at Frog Fountain, take an arrival photo, and use the landmark as a simple starting point for a first walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: A named TCU landmark and clear first meet-up point.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU describes Frog Fountain as a campus landmark and location for student gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; observe current campus access rules.

cards.title: Get Your Bearings at BLUU
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • 2901 Stadium Drive
cards.notes: Walk through the Brown-Lupton University Union, find its information desk, and note the building as a practical waypoint for the rest of campus.
cards.short_summary: A central named building for getting oriented.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU University Unions lists the Brown-Lupton University Union at 2901 Stadium Drive.
cards.access_notes: Indoor access and services can vary; check current union information.

cards.title: Find Your Library Base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • TCU Campus
cards.notes: Locate a study seat in Mary Couts Burnett Library, save the library’s help options, and make a note of its current hours for future visits.
cards.short_summary: A calm stop for setting up a dependable study routine.
cards.evidence_claim: Mary Couts Burnett Library serves TCU’s community of learners and provides physical and virtual learning space.
cards.source_title: About the Library | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s live hours listing before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at Bistro Burnett
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.notes: If you need a quick break while exploring the library, check Bistro Burnett’s current ordering and dining details before making a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A named library dining stop for a short recharge.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Dining lists Bistro Burnett in the library among locations available for Grubhub ordering.
cards.access_notes: Food requires a meal-plan transaction or purchase; verify current hours.

cards.title: Move at the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • 3005 Stadium Drive
cards.notes: Bring your TCU ID, confirm access at check-in, and choose an available recreation option that fits a low-key first evening with friends.
cards.short_summary: An active campus stop before settling into the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Campus Recreation lists the University Recreation Center at 3005 Stadium Drive and publishes facility hours.
cards.access_notes: Facility eligibility and special hours apply; check the current schedule before arrival.

cards.title: Refuel at Shake Smart
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • University Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the dining page to check whether Shake Smart is open after your recreation stop, then choose a snack or drink if you want one.
cards.short_summary: A named campus food stop paired with the Rec Center.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Dining lists Shake Smart at 3005 Stadium Drive in the Campus Rec and publishes its operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; current hours are published by TCU Dining and may change.

cards.title: Walk by Amon G. Carter Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • 2850 Stadium Drive
cards.notes: Make the stadium exterior part of your Saturday walk, then consult TCU Athletics before planning any event attendance or venue entry.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable athletics landmark on the campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Athletics identifies Amon G. Carter Stadium as a TCU athletics facility.
cards.source_title: Amon G. Carter Stadium | TCU Athletics
cards.access_notes: View from exterior public areas; entry is governed by event and venue policies.

cards.title: Cross Sadler Mall
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • TCU Campus
cards.notes: Use the New Frog map to identify Sadler Mall, walk its length, and connect nearby academic buildings to the places you will use during the term.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landscape for linking the academic core.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU’s New Frog guide identifies Sadler Mall as a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus destination; use the current campus map for wayfinding.

cards.title: Take a Garden Walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • 3220 Botanic Garden Boulevard
cards.notes: Plan a daylight visit to the Fort Worth Botanic Garden, choose an area to explore together, and review current visitor requirements before travel.
cards.short_summary: A nearby garden outing that slows the weekend’s pace.
cards.evidence_claim: Fort Worth Botanic Garden provides visitor and admission information for its Fort Worth garden.
cards.access_notes: Admission or timed-entry requirements may apply; verify current visitor information.

cards.title: Finish at the Kimbell
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon • 3333 Camp Bowie Boulevard
cards.notes: Set aside time for the Kimbell’s collection galleries, then check its visitor page for current exhibition access and any ticketing details before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A reflective Sunday cultural stop in Fort Worth’s Cultural District.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kimbell Art Museum publishes visitor information for its collection galleries and exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Check current museum hours and exhibition ticketing requirements before visiting.
